intro: Browser userscripts and agent plugins for AliExpress shopping took up most of the work: tools to hide combo deals, drive purchases through Claude in Chrome, and an index of the scripts. A plugin for developing and publishing Tampermonkey userscripts from inside Claude Code rounded out the repositories.
